heading: Saturday, October 17, 2026
topLine: Mathematicians propose a new journal requiring Lean-verified proofs. Also: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 update.

items.headline: Mathematicians propose a new journal requiring Lean-verified proofs
items.summary: In a guest post on Terence Tao's blog, Shaoming Guo, writing for several colleagues, announced plans for a journal that will accept papers only if their proofs are formally verified in Lean. They cited the risk of subtle errors in LLM-assisted proofs, and said they value how much a paper deepens understanding over being first.

items.headline: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 update
items.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is an update to V4.1-Flash that DeepSeek says scores higher while finishing tasks faster with shorter outputs; it reports 77.0 on DeepSWE v1.1, up from 74.2. Weights are on Hugging Face under the MIT license, and DeepSeek also opened its Search and Fetch APIs to all users.
